summary: Owned the Contacts module of an AI marketing CRM end to end, shipping full-stack features across a 6-person Agile team.
points: Owned the Contacts module of a fully interconnected CRM for an AI marketing platform, delivered by a 6-person Agile team, contributing full-stack across a Django/Python codebase backed by PostgreSQL.

Shipped full CRUD, bulk actions, and soft delete/restore end to end, plus CSV import/export pipelines with live preview, improving data-management workflows for B2B, B2C, eCommerce, and Education clients.

Designed Contacts to auto-link with Accounts and Opportunities so lead conversion creates linked records in a single step, with every action logged to a shared activity timeline for full audit traceability.
Built persona-driven contact classification and buying-group tracking to power Account-Based Marketing, collaborating through code reviews and version control in a fast-paced delivery environment.
